describing in it what took place between him and the people of Siffin

key_terms.أَهْلِ صِفِّينَ: the people of Siffin (the opposing army)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali's letter to the provinces regarding Siffin contain?
ai.summary: This heading introduces Imam Ali’s (AS) comprehensive dispatch to the governors and people of major provinces, serving as an official historical record of the Battle of Siffin. It establishes the theological and political justification for his campaign against Muawiyah, framing the conflict not merely as a civil war but as a struggle to uphold the Caliphate's legitimacy and justice. The text is pivotal in Shia historiography for detailing the nuances of the arbitration (Hakamiyyah) that followed the battle.
